name: North Gate Pass
summary: Travelers cross North Gate Pass through the Khaz Modan peaks between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. A fortified dwarven outpost watches the northern corridor, where travelers bound for the Wetlands pass.

sections.title: Gateway Between the Peaks
sections.body: North Gate Pass cuts through Khaz Modan between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. From the west, you leave steep mountain tunnels for the broad loch valley. Roads lead down toward the Wetlands, carrying dwarven messengers, merchants, and wandering adventurers. North Gate Outpost gives the route its strategic value. Mountaineers there watch for troggs and mountain predators.

faq.q: Where does North Gate Pass lead?
aliases: where does north gate pass go
faq.answer: North Gate Pass links eastern Dun Morogh with northwestern Loch Modan. The road continues north around the loch toward mountain tunnels that descend into the Wetlands, making the pass a vital junction for northern travelers.
Ironforge Mountaineers guard North Gate Outpost beside the road. They watch travelers and keep prowling beasts and roaming troggs from the mountain passage.

faq.q: How does this differ from South Gate Pass?
aliases: difference north and south gate pass
faq.answer: Both passes link Dun Morogh and Loch Modan through carved tunnels. North Gate Pass is the most direct overland route for travelers bound for the Wetlands and northern lands.

angles.text: As a dwarf traveling between Ironforge and the frontier settlements around The Loch, you know North Gate Pass as a familiar, stone-hewn threshold guarded by fellow mountaineers.
As an Alliance traveler, you rely on North Gate Pass as a vital military and supply corridor from the dwarven capital to northern expeditions bound for the Wetlands.
